title: Derby Analyst
overview:
Long-shot betting ticket prediction software with a proven track record in its PC version

The thrill of "hitting it" is right here!

Just enter race data and data on all runners from sources such as racing newspapers, and it pinpoints both favorite and long-shot quinellas. You can also add your own data and arrange the predictions.

G1 race prediction record: 6 wins in 9 races
(March 1 - December 22, 1996), based on the PC version
- '96 Oka Sho, quinella 4-13: 14,230 yen hit! (confidence prediction)
- '96 Tenno Sho (Spring), quinella 1-4: 1,210 yen hit! (long-shot prediction)
- '96 Oaks, quinella 1-15: 1,480 yen hit! (confidence prediction)
- '96 Shuka Sho, quinella 11-15: 15,500 yen hit! (long-shot prediction)
- '96 Tenno Sho (Autumn), quinella 4-8: 2,500 yen hit! (confidence prediction)
- '96 Arima Kinen, quinella 6-11: 900 yen hit! (confidence prediction)

パソコン版で実績の大穴馬券的中予想ソフト

「当てる」快感が、ここにある！

競馬新聞などからレースデータ、全出走馬データを入力するだけで、本線連勝、穴馬連勝をズバリ予測。さらに、ユーザー独自のデータを加え、予想をアレンジすることも可能です。
